confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Amman price levels, not checked against live menus, booking pages or listings. Restaurant and coffee anchors are the firmest. Accommodation (especially dorm and 1-star) and alcohol are less certain because they vary by neighbourhood, season and venue licensing, and Jordan taxes alcohol heavily. cocktail is set at about 2x beer and wine_glass at about 1.5x beer, because direct knowledge of bar and wine prices is weak.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: mid-sized Middle Eastern capital pricing, positioned between lower-cost Cairo and higher-cost Beirut. The Jordanian dinar is pegged to the US dollar, so USD anchors avoid currency drift. Hotel and hostel tiers reflect typical central Amman supply (Downtown, Jabal Amman, Abdoun, Shmeisani). No live listings were consulted.
